title: tanacetum rotundifolium
intro: Tanacetum rotundifolium, commonly known as Blue Tansy, is a flowering plant of the sunflower family, native to Europe and Asia. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Blue Tansy include its ability to calm the nervous system and reduce stress, as well as its use in aromatherapy to alleviate anxiety and promote a sense of well-being. The bioactive constituents of Tanacetum rotundifolium include chamazulene, which has been shown to have potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
